items.name: NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
items.description: The US government repository of standards-based vulnerability management data. Provides CVSS scores, CPE vector strings, and official CVE analysis.

items.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)
items.description: Authoritative catalog of vulnerabilities that have been confirmed to be actively exploited in the wild by threat actors.

items.name: MITRE CVE List
items.description: The global standard dictionary of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE). Primary reference for unique CVE identifiers.

items.name: OSV.dev (Open Source Vulnerabilities)
items.description: Google-backed open source vulnerability database. Aggregates precise package version ranges across npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Maven, and Crates.

items.name: GitHub Security Advisory Database (GHSA)
items.description: Curated security advisories mapping CVEs to GitHub repositories, pull requests, dependencies, and fix commits.

items.name: VulnCheck Intelligence
items.description: High-speed vulnerability intelligence aggregator tracking real-time exploitation status, PoC availability, and patch availability.

items.name: Exploit-DB
items.description: Offensive Security's non-profit archive of public exploits, shellcode drops, and vulnerable software binaries.

items.name: Packet Storm Security
items.description: Information security portal delivering real-time vulnerability advisories, exploit scripts, security tools, and whitepapers.

items.name: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC)
items.description: Official MSRC Security Update Guide for Patch Tuesday releases, Windows kernel LPEs, Win32k, Hyper-V, and Azure advisories.

items.name: Google Project Zero
items.description: Elite zero-day research team analyzing complex memory corruption, browser engine exploits, kernel LPEs, and sandbox escapes.

items.name: Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) Advisories
items.description: Trend Micro's ZDI portal publishing real-time zero-day disclosures, Pwn2Own competition exploits, and vendor patches.

items.name: Ubuntu Security Notices (USN)
items.description: Canonical's security notice database detailing Linux kernel CVEs, eBPF, netfilter, systemd, and glibc security updates.

items.name: Debian Security Information
items.description: Debian Project's security tracker and DSA bulletins for Linux distribution vulnerabilities and package patches.

items.name: Red Hat Security Advisories (RHSA)
items.description: Red Hat Customer Portal tracking enterprise Linux kernel vulnerabilities, CVE severity ratings, and RHSB bulletins.

items.name: The Hacker News (THN)
items.description: Leading cybersecurity news platform covering active cyberattacks, nation-state APTs, zero-day disclosures, and malware campaigns.

items.name: BleepingComputer
items.description: Premier cybersecurity news site specializing in ransomware breakdowns, active zero-day exploitation, and technical incident analysis.

items.name: Dark Reading
items.description: Enterprise cybersecurity news outlet focusing on vulnerability trends, threat intelligence, cloud security, and risk analysis.

items.name: Schneier on Security
items.description: Bruce Schneier's renowned blog covering cryptography, security policy, system design, and fundamental privacy analysis.
